mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing mefloquine metabolism and clearance unpredictably, while both drugs can cause CNS effects and mefloquine has cardiac arrhythmia risk that may be exacerbated by altered drug levels.
action: Monitor for mefloquine efficacy and CNS adverse effects (neuropsychiatric symptoms, dizziness); consider alternative antimalarial if CNS symptoms emerge or if malaria prophylaxis fails.
